name: Context menu
summary: A menu of actions that opens at the pointer on right-click, or from the keyboard with Shift+F10.
description:
Use a context menu as a shortcut for actions on a region: files, cards, canvas items. It is never the only way to reach an action, because nothing on screen shows it exists; put the same actions in a visible menu too.

The menu is an ordinary .v-menu with .v-context-menu. data-v-context on the region names it; right-click opens it at the pointer and Shift+F10 or the Menu key opens it at the focused region. Without JS the browser's own context menu shows.

classes.name: v-context-menu
classes.description: On a .v-menu: placed at the pointer (--v-context-x and --v-context-y, set by the JS) instead of beside a trigger.

states.description: On the region, so it can take focus for Shift+F10 and get focus back when the menu closes.
On the region: name it and mention the shortcut, such as "Project files. Press Shift+F10 for actions."

hooks.name: data-v-context
hooks.description: Opens the menu at the pointer on right-click, or at the focused region on Shift+F10 and the Menu key, keeps it inside the viewport, and returns focus to the region on close.

hooks.name: data-v-menu
hooks.description: Arrow keys, typeahead, checkable items and Escape, as for any dropdown menu.

keyboard.action: On the focused region, opens the menu with focus on the first item.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the region.

a11y: Right-click is invisible: every action in a context menu must also be in a visible control, such as a row's dropdown menu.
Shift+F10 and the Menu key open it from the keyboard, so keyboard and screen reader users get the same shortcut.
Shift with right-click still opens the browser's own menu, for copy, inspect and the rest.

examples.title: File actions
examples.description: Right-click the panel, or focus it and press Shift+F10.
